kind: ephemeral exact original data-upload readback; no persisted schema or installed provider
originals: full original plan/context/operation/allowances, exact source/upload bytes and binding digest, independently retained destination metadata and exact original read bytes
admission: data intent only; same exact target/destination raw ID/source kind, offset, length or chunk hash; known MetadataUpload destination source and original three region sizes; both original attempts still pending and exact original read digest reserved
existing_status_list_response_bound: unchanged 1 MiB; data response reuses canonical claim admission with existing 2 MiB data-codec limit, admitting a full 1 MiB chunk plus Candid overhead
invocation: one already accounted exact read_canister_snapshot_data host replicated update; no hidden retries, metadata/list/status reads, query/proxy substitution or uploads
view: existing exact bounded decoded bytes and raw/request/destination-metadata evidence; original chunk SHA-256 comparison is a passive projection, not a receipt or authenticated outcome
equality: matching bytes may predate this write or come from another writer; differing/absent bytes do not alone prove NotApplied; source/chunk identity and exact range do not establish completeness or exclusive original write attribution
integration_qualification: actual allocation and metadata authenticity, backend readback capability, fresh snapshot read permission/context, chronology, authentication, stable command/byte custody and proof of no prior observation dispatch
failures_and_replay: all failures/drop/death and lost replies retain both pending attempts, consumed spending, originals, source references and obligations; local reconstruction/reopen/association performs no provider invocation, refund, retry or automatic Uncertain receipt
unchanged: existing public signatures/exhaustive errors, all v1 records/digests/bounds, journal spending ownership, dependencies, package version and release receipt
grants: no installed transport/provider, outcome, complete upload, load/start safety, terminal proof or fence/reference release
